blurb: Eighteen Pastures offers a Par 72/75 (Women) golf course sculpted through west coast forests with scenic views. It caters to both low handicappers and beginning players. The course is family-friendly and affordable with weekly specials.
extraNote: Use the Maple Ridge (west) entrance at 280 Street and 108 Avenue, then turn right at 288 St. & 108 Ave. and drive up to the Big Red Barn.
